reasoning: The icon combines a film clapperboard with a person silhouette, clearly representing personal videos, talking-head recordings, vlogs, auditions, or speaker lectures. It fits well for content creation, asynchronous video messages, and acting/casting tasks, though it could occasionally be confused with a live video call or plain user photo card.
